name: Run Run
source:
Her favourite food: I'm hungry.
Her disliked food: I'm hungry.
The subject she teaches: Physical education.

A female panda "Eleven Master" who came out of a sketchbook. Her intentions are hard to read, because the only phrases she uses are "I'm hungry" and "So-so".

[Translated from [url=http://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/%E5%AD%A6%E2%98%86%E7%8E%8B_-THE_ROYAL_SEVEN_STARS-#.E3.82.B5.E3.83.96.E3.82.AD.E3.83.A3.E3.83.A9.E3.82.AF.E3.82.BF.E3.83.BC]the Japanese Wikipedia[/url].]
